title: Vikram and Betal: The Truthful Child
moral: Always tell the truth, even when it is difficult.

scenes.summary: Betal tells a story about a truthful child.
scenes.text: Betal told Vikram about a child who always spoke the truth.
scenes.image_prompt: vikram carrying betal in forest cartoon style

scenes.text: The child accidentally broke a pot while playing.
scenes.image_prompt: child looking at broken pot worried cartoon

scenes.text: The child admitted his mistake honestly.
scenes.image_prompt: child speaking honestly to parents cartoon

scenes.text: The parents praised the child for honesty.
scenes.image_prompt: parents smiling at child proudly cartoon

scenes.text: The king rewarded the child. Vikram answered wisely, and Betal flew away.
scenes.image_prompt: king rewarding child while smiling cartoon

story: A child told the truth after breaking a pot. His honesty was appreciated by his parents and the king. Vikram said truth is more important than mistakes.
